items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: The interviewee confirms the identity ('That's Contrell') and offers an opinion on his drumming ('He was a good drummer'), but does not describe a direct personal, professional, or collaborative relationship with him.

ctx.x: Is it old man Contrell, they call him?

It really should be Contrell. They usually call it Contrell. That's it, Contrell. He wasn't old in those days, but he has a son now, so they usually speak of him as old man Contrell. Contrell. Uh, Baby took a few lessons from him. Natty Dominick started as a drummer with a few lessons from Contrell.
